# God

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII. Nell Says Her Prayers P7](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0007), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)</sub>

## Personality

God is described as inherently good. Additionally, He is characterized by a compassionate and benevolent nature.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)_

## Traits

- good (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021)</sub>
- presumed compassionate and benevolent (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)</sub>

## History

God is mentioned during a discussion between [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) attempts to argue about the consequences of skipping prayers. He is also referenced following Opal's peaceful passing, when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home after the funeral to discuss death and the afterlife.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P63](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0063), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), +2 more_
